title: Mutoro Wakaunza Kuporesa
intro: Mweya wakaedzwa zvisingaperi wakabviswa nyaradzo, shamwari, uye simba remuviri. Ari ega mukutambudzika kukuru, muranda uyu waAllah akatendeukira kuna Mwari chete. Kuburikidza nemoyo murefu usingazununguki uye munamato wemwoyo wese, mafungu etsitsi akasvika kupfuura zvese zvaitarisirwa. Ndiani munhu uyu ane kuzvipira kwakavhura musuwo wekudzorerwa?
clues: Ndaiva muranda waAllah aidiwa, ndichinakidzwa nehupfumi, mhuri yakabudirira, uye hutano hwakanaka mumazuva angu.
Ipapo muedzo wakauya: pfuma yakaenda, vadikani vakaenda, uye nyama yangu yakarohwa nekutambudzika kukuru.
Avo vaiva pedyo neni vakatadza kutsungirira mamiriro angu ezvinhu, uye ndakasiyiwa ndiri ndega, muviri wangu uchitambura.
Ndakadana Ishe wangu, ndichiti Satani akanga andibata nekuneta uye chirango.
Mhinduro yakauya — ndakarairwa kuti ndirove pasi netsoka yangu, uye mvura inotonhorera yakabuda mairi kuti iporeswe.
Ishe wangu vakabvisa matambudziko zvachose uye vakandidzorera mhuri yangu, yakawanda, sechiratidzo chetsitsi kune avo vanofungisisa.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
